1. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure __and a plurality of closed ribs flanking said open rib structure__; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure.

2. (Original) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner.

3. (Original) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure.

4. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure, __wherein said first and second aero covers are integrally formed as a single unified structure__.

5. (Original) The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib.

6. (Original) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib.

7. (Original) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.

8. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel, __wherein said fasteners are positioned at discrete locations spaced along the perimeter of said aero covers__.

9. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress __that are structurally distinct from said plurality of closed ribs__.

10. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress, __and wherein said buttresses provide structural reinforcement independent of said aero covers__.

11. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 7.8 GPa __and a Shore D hardness of at least 80__.

12. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with 40% long glass fibers __and includes mineral filler additives__.

13. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 12, wherein said body panel has a thickness of about 3.5 mm __and exhibits a flexural strength of at least 150 MPa__.

14. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness of about 2.5 mm __and are formed from a thermoplastic material with a lower modulus than said body panel__.

15. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress, __wherein said body panel further includes a plurality of closed ribs positioned between said first and second open rib structures__; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure.

16. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners __positioned at locations distinct from the attachment points of said aero covers__.

17. (Original) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section.

18. (Original) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib.

19. (Original) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib.

20. (Original) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.
